Name: Hardwood From Robin
Author: Suntooth
Description: There's a couple other mods that allow Robin to sell hardwood (namely the ones by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8451]ManaketeSmoocher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11432]MortaliB[/url]﻿), but I wasn't happy with the specifics (the former limited to 10 per day and rather expensive, the latter too cheap), so I decided to make my own. This mod makes Robin sell hardwood with no daily limit. In year 1, each one is 300g. Starting from year 2, the other materials get more expensive, so the hardwood does too - 500g per hardwood.

Manifest.Name: Hardwood From Robin
Manifest.Description: Makes Robin sell hardwood at her shop.
